

```{r}
# Load in packages
library(tidyverse)
library(spDataLarge)
library(sf)
library(stars)
library(terra)
library(gt)
library(tmap)
library(viridisLite)
```

```{r}
# Load in data

## shapefile for the West Coast EEZ
west_cost_eez <- st_read('data/wc_regions_clean.shp')

## bathymetry raster
depth <- rast('data/depth.tif')

## SST rasters (combine SST rasters into a raster stack)
SST8 <- rast('data/average_annual_sst_2008.tif')
SST9 <- rast('data/average_annual_sst_2009.tif')
SST10 <- rast('data/average_annual_sst_2010.tif')
SST11 <- rast('data/average_annual_sst_2011.tif')
SST12 <- rast('data/average_annual_sst_2012.tif')

## Merged SST rasters
SST_merge <- c(SST8, SST9, SST10, SST11, SST12)
plot(SST_merge)

## find the mean SST from 2008-2012 (e.g. create single raster of average SST)
SST_mean <- mean(SST_merge, na.rm = TRUE)

plot(SST_mean)

## convert average SST from Kelvin to Celsius (hint: subtract by 273.15)
SST_celsius <- SST_mean - 273.15

crs(SST8)
```

```{r}
# Check for same CRS for all datasets
cat("\n=== Same CRS? ===\n")
cat("west cost ezz vs depth: ", same.crs(west_cost_eez, depth), "\n")
cat("west cost ezz vs SST merge: ", same.crs(west_cost_eez, SST_mean), "\n")
cat("depth vs SST merge: ", same.crs(depth, SST_mean), "\n")
```


```{r}
# Process data

## crop depth raster to match the extent of the SST raster (note: the resolutions of the SST and depth data do not match)

depth_crop <- crop(depth, SST_celsius)
plot(depth_crop)

cat("depth:", dim(depth), "\n")
cat("depth_crop:", dim(depth_crop), "\n")
cat("SST celsius:", dim(SST_celsius), "\n")


## resample the depth data to match the resolution of the SST data using the bilinear method approach

resample_depth <- resample(depth_crop, y = SST_celsius, method = "bilinear")
dim(resample_depth)
plot(resample_depth)

## check that the depth and SST match in resolution, extent, and coordinate reference system (hint: can the rasters be stacked?)

sst_depth_zones <- c(SST_celsius, resample_depth)
plot(sst_depth_zones)
```


```{r}
# reclassify SST and depth data into locations that are suitable for oysters (hint: set suitable values to 1 and unsuitable values to 0)

rcl_sst <- matrix(
    c(-Inf, 11, 0, # Not suitable 
      11, 30, 1, # Suitable
      30, Inf, 0 # Not suitable
    ),
    ncol = 3,
    byrow = TRUE)

rcl_depth <- matrix(
    c(-Inf, -70, 0, # Not suitable 
      -70, 0, 1, # Suitable
      0, Inf, 0 # Not suitable
    ),
    ncol = 3,
    byrow = TRUE)

zone_SST <- classify(SST_celsius, rcl = rcl_sst)

zone_depth <- classify(resample_depth, rcl = rcl_depth)

plot(zone_SST)
plot(zone_depth)

depth_SST_zones <- c(zone_SST, zone_depth)
plot(depth_SST_zones)
```

```{r}
suitable_zones <- lapp(depth_SST_zones, fun = function(sst, depth) sst * depth)

plot(suitable_zones)


# Making EEZ crs equal oyster_suitability CRS
sf::st_crs(west_cost_eez) <- terra::crs(suitable_zones)

# Converting sf object to terra SpatVector
# eez_vect <- terra::vect(west_cost_eez)

ezz_raster <- rasterize(west_cost_eez, suitable_zones, field = 'rgn_id')

plot(ezz_raster)

# cellsize()
cellsize <- cellSize(suitable_zones, unit = "km", mask = TRUE)

plot(suitable_cellSize)
# mask()
suitable_zone_mask <- mask(cellsize, suitable_zones, maskvalues = 0)

plot(suitable_zone_mask)

# zonal()
zone <- zonal(suitable_zone_mask, ezz_raster, fun = "sum", na.rm = TRUE)


# tibble()

zone_tibble <- as_tibble(zone)


# map
# Joining suitable area to EEZ polygons
eez_map <- left_join(west_cost_eez, zone_tibble, by = "rgn_id")

# Creating map
tm_shape(eez_map) +
    tm_basemap("OpenStreetMap") +
    tm_fill(
      fill = "area",
      fill.legend = tm_legend(title = "Suitable Area (km^2)")
    ) +
    tmap_options(component.autoscale = FALSE) +
    tm_borders(lwd = .8) +
    tm_title(paste("Suitable", "species_name", "Habitats by West Coast EEZ"), size = 1)

```

Oysters:

* SST: 11-30 deg C
* depth: 0-70 m below sea level
